parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: AclEntryList
parameters.description: The IP addresses or CIDR blocks in the IP address whitelist.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse update-acl --acl-entry-list 192.168.0.0/XX,192.168.0.0/XX --instance-id mse-cn-78v1l830000 --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
